reviewer: root technical source peer, not GitHub CODEOWNER approval
source_review: Read the capture, closed projections, exact code-object bindings, owned hook aliases, child dispatch, parent forwarding, original CLI wrapper, installed admission, ledger reconstruction, strict reader, retention and workflow.

Owned original call arguments, return object identity and exception identity are preserved. No capture lock spans an original call. Observation setup or export failure cannot replace an already obtained original operation result; missing or incomplete reports fail separate diagnostic admission.

Capture records the original function's selected operands, actual original local monotonic clock return and publisher state around existing calls. It adds no native/HTTP probe, readiness retry, getter or new workload call. State timestamps bracket observation, not an internal publication commit.

Short-circuit control coverage exercises minimum generation, policy action, strict overlay, valid signed mismatched readback, withdrawn ACK, original deadline and withdrawal during readback. Equal observed/unobserved getter counts are asserted. No native result is inferred from the Python-written signed control fixtures.

Report admission requires original publisher containment, zero in-flight callbacks, exact single dispatch per cell, restored hooks/dispatch patch, two original fixture factories, original roster/ledger round-trip and installed runtime identity. Loss, overflow, unknown caller, altered outcome or missing report is refused.

Closed builtin projection bounds avoid invoking custom mapping/hash hooks. Raw command/private values and error text are not exported by the diagnostic; approved enums, digests, source code labels and fixed exception kinds are retained.

Noneditable installed package files and native image are admitted before and after; every packaged Python source matches the current source except the exact declared legacy exclusion. The original runner also rejects a source-tree package origin. Historical artifact build identity is preserved.

Source and driver guards bind clean Git trees and every selected file before/after. Original built-in observer/witness/clocks remain unchanged. No headline timing or whole-matrix qualification is permitted.

resolved_findings.resolution: Require the existing original publisher_contained result; no new probe. One negative reader case added; final58 controls passed.

operational_completion: Owner may compose exact isolated driver lineage and create the unique unused branch after its fresh ref, source/tree, workflow trigger and all-byte checks. Only reviewed diagnostic leaves/workflow isolation may differ; a substantive source delta needs a new review. Do not mutate PR or evidence refs, repeat existing populations, or request duplicate root/CI approval for mechanical binding.
limits: Hooks activate at selected dispatch. Publisher operations entered before activation are outside capture completeness; background calls can have no await parent.
Added observer work is inside some original measured intervals. This is explanatory diagnostic evidence only; no subtraction of unmeasured overhead or historical cause from nonreproduction.

The authentic retained Linux artifact came from a cancelled normal job. Its binary/source identity is useful for this separate finite diagnostic; absent original soak/pure-wheel membership is not reconstructed.
Original selected cells may fail while diagnostic capture is complete. Preserve both outcomes and all original bytes.
Technical peer clearance is not eligible GitHub approval or acceptance of RSP128/129/137.
